Scarlet & Violet series · PAF

Paldean Fates

Released January 26, 2024 · 245 cards

StandardExpanded

Paldean Fates is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Scarlet & Violet series, released in English on January 26, 2024. Its main set has 91 cards, plus 154 secret rares numbered beyond the set (245 in total). It includes 219 Pokémon, 26 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.

Illustrators

92 illustrators worked on Paldean Fates. Most cards: Kouki Saitou (10), 5ban Graphics (9), nagimiso (8), Shin Nagasawa (8), Kagemaru Himeno (7), Sanosuke Sakuma (7), GOSSAN (6), Hitoshi Ariga (6).
